context:
Goal: banchi's merge tool keeps working after the required check on main was removed.
Problem (risk): banchi's .github/stamp.json names merge.requiredChecks "protection"; with no protection check on main the merge tool stops. PR banchi #1106 (head 0ec884639e5fa3e913d367cbea60a2532e5db015, as runner 12 reported; live head unread, this session has no GitHub access to banchi) is a one-line change that pins it to ["all-jobs-passed"]. No owner word names #1106, and the auto-mode classifier denied runner 12's merge step, so it needs your word on that exact PR.
Based on (read): coordinator relay 19:31 CST Nov 15: runner 12 searched first and found no existing PR or branch; the other four repos (q_max, mailaudit, ios-adblock, joyous) already pin it, per runner 12 (relayed, not checked by triage).
Based on (read): runner 12's report at 19:34 CST Nov 15 (its word, relayed by the coordinator; banchi is unreadable to triage): a Sonnet review at head 0ec884639e5f (live head matched) PASS with no findings (reviewer Sonnet, round 2 of 3); the record with both rounds is PR comment 6904882124 (round 1 Haiku PASS, round 2 Sonnet PASS). It read that the rollup job is named exactly all-jobs-passed, and that banchi's main ruleset is empty while classic protection holds ["all-jobs-passed"], so the pin equals today's list.
Departs from: banchi main today — requiredChecks "protection" (stops the merge tool once main has no protection check) — one line sets the named list ["all-jobs-passed"].
ORDER: #1106 must merge BEFORE you remove the check from banchi's protection, because the merge tool reads the config from origin/main, and "protection" with no check left stops #1106's own merge (same trap as claude-settings). Unknown: what you leave in protection after removal.
Also bears on your ask for a bash to turn the check off on every repo: each repo whose stamp reads "protection" needs the pin on main first; per runner 12, q_max, mailaudit, ios-adblock and joyous already pin it.
The grant covers only the named act: merge of banchi #1106 at that head. Held behind it: banchi #1104, mailaudit #331 and ios-adblock #173.
ANSWER (chat, relayed): option a "Yes, #1106 only", owner chat 19:40 CST Nov 15, relayed by the consultant, verbatim "yes on 905" (not a page save). Runner 12 has not yet confirmed the merge; a receiver needs the grant checked from the page or typed in its own session.
holds: Merges in banchi stop, and banchi #1104, mailaudit #331 and ios-adblock #173 stay held.

lastAnswer.note: yes on 905 (owner chat 19:40 CST Nov 15, relayed by the consultant, not a page save)

options.gain: banchi merges work again, and #1104, mailaudit #331 and ios-adblock #173 un-hold.
options.how: The merge tool merges banchi #1106 at head 0ec884639e5f, nothing else.
options.label: Yes, #1106 only
options.lose: A pin to a check that is no longer required on main, until the pin is rewritten; revert is one PR.

options.label: No, hold
options.lose: Four PRs stay held and runner 12 waits.

ref: banchi PR #1106 (pin merge.requiredChecks to all-jobs-passed), PRs #1104, mailaudit #331, ios-adblock #173
title: May the merge tool merge banchi #1106, which pins requiredChecks to all-jobs-passed?
why: One line, one-PR revert, a Sonnet review passed at the live head, and four held PRs wait on it.
